message: I rushed the lowering part of every chin-up today. How can I fix that during the next session?
answer: Use sets short enough that you can lower each chin-up under control back to your starting position. If your last reps drop quickly, stop a rep earlier or use assistance for the remaining sets.

message: After a loaded carry I noticed my training partner's face drooping and their words were slurred. What do I do?
answer: Call your local emergency number now and say you suspect a stroke. Note when they were last known well, keep them safe and resting, and follow the dispatcher's instructions.
